resources.string: Study-only synthetic data. This app writes 1 step to Health Connect approximately every 2 seconds while the generator is running.
Why Synthetic Step Lab requests step write access

Synthetic Step Lab is a local study utility. It requests permission only to write synthetic step records to Health Connect when you press Start. It does not request permission to read your Health Connect data. The generated records are attributed to Synthetic Step Lab and remain under Health Connect’s normal user controls, where you can review or delete them.
